title: editor adaptive layout refactor
description:
spec 2026-11-12 section 9 failure mode J (hardcoded dims) residue the
commit-b restructure surfaced: the zebra toggle sat at
padding(start = 8dp, top = 64dp) — a hardcoded positional offset that
silently assumed the scope toggle above it was exactly 48dp tall (8dp
inset + 48dp button + 8dp gap). any future change to the scope
toggle's size (a larger scrim, a different glyph) would have left the
two buttons overlapping or drifting apart with no code change to
blame.

the two topstart controls now compose in one vertically-stacked column
at the video rect's real topstart corner: the zebra button sits below
the scope button by the stack's own geometry (the toggle's measured
height plus an 8dp spacer), never a magic offset. same visual result
on today's sizes (48 + 8 = the old 64), same 48dp iconbutton targets,
same 8dp corner inset, same scrim language. the mini overlay keeps
bottomstart an
changed: fix: cap panel anchors at preview width claim
fix: anchor corner controls to the video rect
fix: derive the corner stack, drop the magic 64dp
